title: Brilliantly Optimized (Android/LowEnd Edition)
description: Optimization mods, no filler, only for low-end/arm devices.
body:
Mainly for lowend or android devices, aiming for less CPU/GPU usage and performance than just purely performance. If you want a purely optimization focused pack and have good enough specs, try the other modpacks I have. 

If you want your mod gone or have an issue, contact me on discord. (@quippykc).

DISABLE VOXY IF YOU DON'T WANT THE RENDER DISTANCE, YOU'LL LOSE A LOT OF FPS IF YOU DON'T.

If you want purely FPS, get the Vulkan version as I get 2-3x~ FPS. (If your on a low-end device supporting Vulkan)
